source_review.notes: Reviewed Aggarwal-Vitter's primary external-sort analysis, CMU's B+ tree notes, current PostgreSQL CREATE INDEX, ordered scan, tuplesort source, and nbtree maintainer documentation, plus current MySQL sorted-build and physical-index documentation. All eight final destinations returned HTTP 200. Vendor behavior is scoped to the cited implementations and not generalized as the definition of bulk loading.

evidence: Checked n, M, B, runs, pages, fan-out, leaf capacity, leaf count, output size, build generation, snapshot, and log interval notation.
Checked complete entry identity, unique-key comparison, fill target, source/run/leaf digest, endpoint, and visibility terminology remain distinct.
Checked logical page visits, physical I/O, emitted/filtered entries, base fetches, latency, and amplification are not conflated.
notation_and_syntax.notes: External-memory bounds retain their model/regime qualifications and are not converted to wall-clock claims.

evidence: Recomputed floor(4*0.75)=3 and eleven inputs grouped as 3,3,3,2 with separators 7,17,29.
Recomputed scan 6 through 23: routing enters the first leaf, emits six values, and touches four leaves before observing 29 beyond the bound.
Recomputed 1001-entry exercise: eleven pages of 91 total exactly 1001 and each satisfies the 50..100 legal interval near target 90.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The finite examples use count capacity; production packing must recompute exact encoded-byte feasibility.

evidence: Re-derived external comparison-sort transfer shape Theta((n/B) log base M/B of n/B) and sequential construction/audit Theta(n/B).
Verified sorted partition plus right-lower-bound separator synthesis preserves ordered union and routes each entry to its unique leaf.
Verified ideal range shape combines one logarithmic seek with output leaf traversal, while filtering/base fetches remain additional work.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Online-build equality additionally depends on a gap-free snapshot/capture/replay/cutover protocol.

evidence: Reviewed empty/single page, exact fit, maximum entry, tiny tail, internal singleton tail, duplicates, nulls, collation drift, expression failure, overflow, and compressed boundaries.
Reviewed corrupt/truncated/reordered runs, count/hash cancellation, manifest mismatch, ENOSPC, cancellation, restart, orphan generation, allocator leak, and torn publication.
Reviewed snapshot/capture gaps, abort/retry, key-changing updates, uniqueness races, long transactions, replica lag, scan split/delete/reclaim races, token expiry, and weak physical locality.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: The executable model covers only sorted unique integers, one internal root, count capacity, and exclusive atomic construction.

evidence: The model rejects unsorted or duplicate input and checks every leaf is nonempty and within maximum capacity.
It checks chain order equals the exact source list, separators equal right-leaf minima, all adjacent links and terminal null, and every source entry routes to its containing leaf.
Exact output checks counts, target, pages, separators, height, range result, pages touched, chain order, and aggregate validity.
invariant_checking.notes: The final two-entry leaf is a declared legal tail in this model; no general minimum-occupancy theorem is inferred.

evidence: Reviewed construction from frozen definition/snapshot through complete extraction, multiset-preserving run merge, legal leaf partition, chain, parent induction, and independent reconciliation.
Reviewed online publication from gap-free capture, exact idempotent committed effects, cutover equality, durable private generation, atomic root/catalog selection, and delayed reclamation.
Reviewed range correctness from lower-bound routing, leaf order, visibility/predicate, endpoint stop, total-identity continuation, and concurrent validation/restart obligations.
proof_review.notes: These are scoped proof structures and review obligations, not a verified database implementation or online DDL protocol.

evidence: Construction, online publication, and range proof structures are separately labeled with assumptions.
Count/digest reconciliation limitations, logical versus physical locality, and current vendor examples are explicit.
Finite model execution, source reachability, fault-test prescriptions, and performance measurement are not represented as universal proof.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: A fast or dense build is never treated as proof of snapshot completeness, durability, or range correctness.

evidence: The standard-library Python model passed exact twelve-line stdout, empty stderr, and zero exit status under the repository verifier.
It reproduced four linked leaves, separators 7,17,29, six inclusive scan results, four touched leaves, exact chain union, and valid=True.
All eight external destinations returned HTTP 200 and repository-local structure/link checks passed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No extraction, external runs/merge, byte pages, real I/O, online capture, concurrency, WAL, crash recovery, replication, fuzzing, or performance benchmark was executed.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter connects complete total-order extraction and external sorting to legal bottom-up page construction, online snapshot reconciliation, atomic generation publication, and exact output-sensitive range semantics.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed definition pinning, run manifests, byte/tail feasibility, identity reconciliation, online replay, uniqueness, cutover, replicas, crash/restart/cleanup, cursor APIs, capacity limits, observability, and correctness-first build/scan benchmarks.

pedagogical_review.notes: The one-page review supplies the end-to-end invariants; the exact model exposes fill, tail, separators, and scan stopping; ten examples cover offline, online, recovery, validation, and performance failures; five exercises provide complete production designs and audits.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary/maintainer-source, mathematical, bounded executable-model, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external academic, Aggarwal, Vitter, CMU, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, database, storage-engine, data-engineering, concurrency, reliability, security, performance, or independent practitioner review is claimed. The chapter and model prove neither source extraction, external sorting code, byte packing, an online build, unique validation, catalog/WAL/recovery, replication, concurrent range scans, migration, physical locality, production performance, certification, nor deployment fitness.
